interaction.prompt: Your teammate has the puck but a defender is on them. Drag YOURSELF to open ice where they can pass to you.

feedback.right: Good support. You found open ice away from the defender, so your teammate has an easy pass and you have time with the puck.
feedback.wrong: Standing behind the defender or right beside your teammate gives them no good pass. Find the open ice where nobody is covering you.

tip: When a teammate has the puck, skate to open ice where they can see you and pass to you.
why: Supporting the puck means giving your teammate an easy, open passing option instead of leaving them alone against a defender.
